name: Thunderwake Storm
introDiscord:
Static flashes through a storm trapped between enormous ribs.

Thunderwake Squid fill the dark water with glowing ink and electricity.
introTwitch:
Static flashes through a storm trapped between enormous ribs.

Thunderwake Squid fill the dark water with glowing ink and electricity.

thunderwake-storm-approach.prompt: Three paths flash beneath the storm.

left.message:
A Thunderwake Squid releases glowing ink.

Lightning immediately travels through it.

Creative.

Rude.

right.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's insulated pouch:

'Glimmer tried glowing brighter than lightning.

Lightning won.

Glimmer requests rematch.

Denied.'

forward.message: A strongbox glints beneath the electric water.

left.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Static recovery.

Hair situation unrecoverable.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the medicine.

Hair prognosis remains unclear.

right.message: A Squid turns the current purple with storm ink.

forward.message: Star Candies rest beneath an enormous scale.

left.message: A navigator's chest sits beneath a grounded rib.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle:

'Glimmer rematch occurred without authorization.

Lightning still champion.'

forward.message: A Thunderwake Squid flashes from inside the storm.

boss-antechamber.name: Electric Gyre
boss-antechamber.prompt: The electric storm abruptly turns black with ink.

bossPromptDiscord:
The electric storm abruptly turns black with ink.

Lightning flashes inside the cloud.

Something enormous unfolds within it.

Use /yes to enter Electric Gyre or /no to accept lightning's undefeated
record.
bossPromptTwitch:
The electric storm abruptly turns black with ink.

Lightning flashes inside the cloud.

Something enormous unfolds within it.

Use !yes to enter Electric Gyre or !no to accept lightning's undefeated
record.
bossRetreatText: You retreat beyond the charged current.

boss.revealText:
Massive tentacles break through the storm cloud.

Storm-Ink Architeuthis reveals itself!

completionText:
The storm disperses.

Glimmer remains 0–2 against atmospheric electricity.
